verdict.rationale: Requesty is an LLM gateway, and the evidence documents only request-time routing behaviors such as fallback retries, load balancing, auto caching and latency routing. Service accounts for non-human callers are a developer building block, not a feature for setting up background automations, scheduled jobs, triggers or autonomous runs. These are adjacent features and earn no credit, so the applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
